words.def: what you think or believe about something
a word or phrase with a particular meaning
the ability to make good decisions about what to do
an explanation of exactly what a word or idea means
a change that happens because of something else
to make someone agree to do or believe something
very much; in a serious and thorough way
the fact that you can do something
having the skill, time or chance to do something
something good that you succeed in doing after effort
the act of choosing, or the range of things you can choose from
a situation in which it is possible for you to do something
a series of actions that lead to a particular result
to officially control a country or an area
the group of people who control a country
one piece of writing that someone puts on social media
the short text written under a photo or a video
a word or phrase after the sign #, used to mark a topic

steps.title: Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ give an opinion and mark it as one — In my opinion… / I’d say… / If you ask me…
✓ ask somebody else for theirs — What do you reckon? / How do you feel about…?
✓ agree strongly, and give ground without agreeing completely
✓ disagree without sounding hard — I see what you mean, but… / I’m not so sure
✓ tell an informal phrase from a formal one, and choose the right one
✓ write a social-media thread that says something and asks something back
